overview: Stay 2 nights in Singapore, 2 nights in Manila, 3 nights in Boracay and 4 nights in Bali, in 4-star hotels with breakfast.

Combine Singapore sightseeing, Manila nightlife, Boracay island hopping and a sunset cruise with private Bali tours. Entry tickets and optional water activities are excluded unless explicitly included.
The brochure lists 3 international and 2 domestic flights, airport transfers and 7 kg cabin plus 20 kg checked baggage per person. Final routing, hotels and availability are confirmed in your quote.
paymentPolicy: 50% of the package cost at booking; remaining 50% at least 25 days before travel.
Booking documents: passport scan and PAN card, with the booking advance.

faqs.question: How many nights are included?
faqs.answer: 11 hotel nights: Singapore 2, Manila 2, Boracay 3 and Bali 4, with breakfast in 4-star hotels.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Philippines & Bali package?
faqs.answer: No. This combination also includes two nights in Singapore, shared airport transfers and a half-day Singapore sightseeing tour.

faqs.question: Are activity entry tickets included?
faqs.answer: The listed sightseeing transport is included. Singapore and Bali entry tickets and optional water activities are excluded; check the full inclusions and exclusions.

faqs.question: Are taxes included?
faqs.answer: ₹1,49,999 is the brochure offer per person. Applicable GST/TCS is extra; final pricing is confirmed in your quote.
